title: MAKING THE MOST OF TRENDS
subtitle: Experts from Harvard Business School give advice to managers

sentences.en: Most managers can identify the major trends of the day.
sentences.zh: 大多数管理者都能识别当下的主要趋势。

grammar.type: 简单句
grammar.note: 主语 Most managers，谓语 can identify，宾语 the major trends of the day。

sentences.en: But in the course of conducting research in a number of industries and working directly with companies, we have discovered that managers often fail to recognize the less obvious but profound ways these trends are influencing consumers' aspirations, attitudes, and behaviors.
sentences.zh: 但我们在多个行业开展研究并直接与企业合作时发现，管理者往往没有看出：这些趋势正以不太明显却影响深远的方式，改变消费者的愿望、态度和行为。

grammar.type: 宾语从句 + 省略关系词的定语从句
grammar.note: that 引导 discovered 的宾语从句；these trends are influencing... 是省略关系词的定语从句，修饰 ways；less obvious but profound 为并列形容词。

sentences.en: This is especially true of trends that managers view as peripheral to their core markets.
sentences.zh: 对于那些被管理者视为与核心市场关系不大的趋势，这种情况尤其常见。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + view as
grammar.note: that... 修饰 trends；view A as B 表示“把 A 看作 B”；This 指代上一句所说的忽视现象。

sentences.en: Many ignore trends in their innovation strategies or adopt a wait-and-see approach and let competitors take the lead.
sentences.zh: 许多管理者在创新战略中忽视趋势，或者采取观望态度，让竞争对手抢先行动。

grammar.type: 并列谓语 + let sb do
grammar.note: ignore 与 adopt 由 or 连接；adopt 与 let 由 and 连接；let competitors take 不带 to。

sentences.en: At a minimum, such responses mean missed profit opportunities.
sentences.zh: 轻则，这些做法会让企业错失盈利机会。

grammar.type: 简单句
grammar.note: At a minimum 表示至少会出现的后果；missed profit opportunities 为宾语。

sentences.en: At the extreme, they can jeopardize a company by ceding to rivals the opportunity to transform the industry.
sentences.zh: 重则，企业把改造行业的机会让给对手，甚至可能危及自身。

grammar.type: by doing 方式状语 + 不定式定语
grammar.note: by ceding... 说明 jeopardize 的方式；to transform the industry 修饰 opportunity。

sentences.en: The purpose of this article is twofold: to spur managers to think more expansively about how trends could engender new value propositions in their core markets, and to provide some high-level advice on how to make market research and product development personnel more adept at analyzing and exploiting trends.
sentences.zh: 本文有两个目的：促使管理者更广泛地思考趋势如何在核心市场中催生新的价值主张；并就如何提高市场研究和产品开发人员分析、利用趋势的能力，提供一些总体建议。

grammar.type: 冒号解释 + 两个并列不定式
grammar.note: to spur... 与 to provide... 并列解释 twofold；两个 how 从句分别作 about 和 on 的宾语；make personnel more adept 为复合结构。

sentences.en: One strategy, known as ‘infuse and augment’, is to design a product or service that retains most of the attributes and functions of existing products in the category but adds others that address the needs and desires unleashed by a major trend.
sentences.zh: 第一种策略称为“注入并扩充”：设计一项产品或服务，保留该品类现有产品的大部分特点和功能，同时增加能够满足某项重大趋势所激发的新需求与愿望的特点。

grammar.type: 过去分词插入语 + 多层定语从句
grammar.note: known as... 修饰 strategy；that retains...but adds... 修饰 product or service；that address... 修饰 others；unleashed... 修饰 needs and desires。

sentences.en: A case in point is the Poppy range of handbags, which the firm Coach created in response to the economic downturn of 2008.
sentences.zh: 蔻驰公司为应对2008年的经济衰退而推出 Poppy 系列手袋，这就是一个典型案例。

grammar.type: 非限制性定语从句
grammar.note: which... 修饰 the Poppy range of handbags；in response to 表示产品推出的背景和原因。

sentences.en: The Coach brand had been a symbol of opulence and luxury for nearly 70 years, and the most obvious reaction to the downturn would have been to lower prices.
sentences.zh: 近70年来，蔻驰一直是富足与奢华的象征；面对经济衰退，最直接的反应本来会是降价。

grammar.type: 过去完成时 + would have done
grammar.note: and 连接两个分句；had been 说明此前长期状态；would have been 表示在当时看来可能采取的做法。

sentences.en: However, that would have risked cheapening the brand's image.
sentences.zh: 然而，这样做可能会损害品牌的高端形象。

grammar.type: would have done + risk doing
grammar.note: that 指代降价；would have risked 表示可能后果；risk 后接动名词 cheapening。

sentences.en: Instead, they initiated a consumer-research project which revealed that customers were eager to lift themselves and the country out of tough times.
sentences.zh: 他们转而开展消费者研究，结果发现顾客希望自己和国家都能走出艰难时期。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 宾语从句
grammar.note: which revealed... 修饰 project；that 引导 revealed 的宾语从句；be eager to do 表示迫切希望。

sentences.en: Using these insights, Coach launched the lower-priced Poppy handbags, which were in vibrant colors, and looked more youthful and playful than conventional Coach products.
sentences.zh: 蔻驰根据这些研究发现推出了价格较低的 Poppy 手袋，采用鲜艳配色，外观比传统蔻驰产品更年轻、更活泼。

grammar.type: 分词状语 + 非限制性定语从句
grammar.note: Using these insights 表示依据；which... 补充说明 handbags；were 与 looked 为并列谓语；more...than... 构成比较。

sentences.en: Creating the sub-brand allowed Coach to avert an across-the-board price cut.
sentences.zh: 创立这一子品牌，使蔻驰避免了全线降价。

grammar.type: 动名词主语 + allow sb to do
grammar.note: Creating the sub-brand 作主语；allow Coach to avert... 表示使公司能够避免。

sentences.en: In contrast to the many companies that responded to the recession by cutting prices, Coach saw the new consumer mindset as an opportunity for innovation and renewal.
sentences.zh: 许多公司以降价应对经济衰退，蔻驰则不同，它把消费者的新心态视为创新和更新的机会。

grammar.type: 对比状语 + 定语从句 + see as
grammar.note: In contrast to... 引出对比；that responded... 修饰 companies；see A as B 表示“把 A 看作 B”。

sentences.en: A further example of this strategy was supermarket Tesco's response to consumers' growing concerns about the environment.
sentences.zh: 这一策略的另一个例子，是超市企业乐购对消费者日益关注环境问题所作的回应。

grammar.type: 主系表结构
grammar.note: A further example 为主语；Tesco's response... 为表语；about the environment 修饰 concerns。

sentences.en: With that in mind, Tesco, one of the world's top five retailers, introduced its Greener Living program, which demonstrates the company's commitment to protecting the environment by involving consumers in ways that produce tangible results.
sentences.zh: 考虑到这一点，全球五大零售商之一乐购推出“绿色生活”计划，让消费者参与能产生实际效果的环保行动，以此表明公司的环保承诺。

grammar.type: 同位语 + 非限制性定语从句
grammar.note: one of... 是 Tesco 的同位语；which 修饰 program；by involving... 说明展示承诺的方式；that produce... 修饰 ways。

sentences.en: For example, Tesco customers can accumulate points for such activities as reusing bags, recycling cans and printer cartridges, and buying home-insulation materials.
sentences.zh: 例如，乐购顾客重复使用购物袋、回收易拉罐和打印机墨盒，或购买家庭保温材料，都可以累积积分。

grammar.type: such as 举例 + 并列动名词
grammar.note: such activities as 后列出 reusing、recycling、buying 三项并列活动。

sentences.en: Like points earned on regular purchases, these green points can be redeemed for cash.
sentences.zh: 与日常购物所得积分一样，这些绿色积分可以兑换现金。

grammar.type: 过去分词定语 + 被动语态
grammar.note: earned on regular purchases 修饰 points；can be redeemed 为情态动词被动语态。

sentences.en: Tesco has not abandoned its traditional retail offerings but augmented its business with these innovations, thereby infusing its value proposition with a green streak.
sentences.zh: 乐购没有放弃传统零售业务，而是用这些创新扩充业务，从而在其价值主张中加入环保内容。

grammar.type: not...but... + 分词结果状语
grammar.note: has not abandoned 与 (has) augmented 形成转折；thereby infusing... 说明扩充业务的结果。

sentences.en: A more radical strategy is ‘combine and transcend’.
sentences.zh: 一种更激进的策略是“结合并超越”。

grammar.type: 主系表结构
grammar.note: A more radical strategy 为主语；引号内名称作表语。

sentences.en: This entails combining aspects of the product's existing value proposition with attributes addressing changes arising from a trend, to create a novel experience - one that may land the company in an entirely new market space.
sentences.zh: 这种策略把产品现有价值主张的部分内容，与针对趋势变化的新特点结合起来，创造一种新体验；这种体验可能把公司带入全新的市场空间。

grammar.type: entail doing + 分词定语 + 同位语
grammar.note: entails 后接 combining；addressing... 修饰 attributes，arising... 修饰 changes；to create 表目的；one 是 experience 的同位语，that 修饰 one。

sentences.en: At first glance, spending resources to incorporate elements of a seemingly irrelevant trend into one's core offerings sounds like it's hardly worthwhile.
sentences.zh: 乍看之下，投入资源，把一个似乎不相关的趋势纳入核心产品，好像并不值得。

grammar.type: 动名词主语 + sound like
grammar.note: spending resources... 为主语；to incorporate... 说明资源用于何处；it's hardly worthwhile 作 like 的宾语从句。

sentences.en: But consider Nike's move to integrate the digital revolution into its reputation for high-performance athletic footwear.
sentences.zh: 但可以看看耐克的做法：它把数字革命融入自己在高性能运动鞋领域的声誉。

grammar.type: 祈使句 + 不定式定语
grammar.note: consider 为祈使句谓语；to integrate... 修饰 Nike's move；integrate A into B 表示“把 A 融入 B”。

sentences.en: In 2006, they teamed up with technology company Apple to launch Nike+, a digital sports kit comprising a sensor that attaches to the running shoe and a wireless receiver that connects to the user's iPod.
sentences.zh: 2006年，耐克与科技公司苹果合作推出 Nike+。这套数字运动设备包括一个安装在跑鞋上的传感器，以及一个连接用户 iPod 的无线接收器。

grammar.type: 不定式目的状语 + 同位语 + 定语从句
grammar.note: to launch... 表合作目的；a digital sports kit 是 Nike+ 的同位语；comprising... 修饰 kit；两个 that 从句分别修饰 sensor 和 receiver。

sentences.en: By combining Nike's original value proposition for amateur athletes with one for digital consumers, the Nike+ sports kit and web interface moved the company from a focus on athletic apparel to a new plane of engagement with its customers.
sentences.zh: Nike+ 把耐克面向业余运动者的原有价值主张，与面向数字产品消费者的价值主张结合起来，使公司从专注运动服饰，转向与顾客建立一种新的互动关系。

grammar.type: By doing 方式状语 + from...to...
grammar.note: By combining... 说明方式；one 指代 value proposition；moved the company from...to... 表示定位转变。

sentences.en: A third approach, known as ‘counteract and reaffirm’, involves developing products or services that stress the values traditionally associated with the category in ways that allow consumers to oppose - or at least temporarily escape from - the aspects of trends they view as undesirable.
sentences.zh: 第三种方法称为“抵消并重申”：开发强调该品类传统价值的产品或服务，让消费者能够对抗，或至少暂时摆脱，他们认为不理想的趋势影响。

grammar.type: 过去分词插入语 + 多层定语从句
grammar.note: known as... 修饰 approach；involves 后接 developing；that stress... 修饰 products or services；that allow... 修饰 ways；they view as undesirable 修饰 aspects。

sentences.en: A product that accomplished this is the ME2, a video game created by Canada's iToys.
sentences.zh: 加拿大 iToys 公司开发的视频游戏 ME2，就是采用这种方法的产品。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 同位语
grammar.note: that accomplished this 修饰 A product；a video game... 是 ME2 的同位语；created by... 修饰 game。

sentences.en: By reaffirming the toy category's association with physical play, the ME2 counteracted some of the widely perceived negative impacts of digital gaming devices.
sentences.zh: ME2 重新强调玩具与身体活动之间的联系，从而抵消了人们普遍认为数字游戏设备会带来的一些负面影响。

grammar.type: By doing 方式状语 + 过去分词定语
grammar.note: By reaffirming... 说明抵消负面影响的方式；widely perceived 修饰 negative impacts。

sentences.en: Like other handheld games, the device featured a host of exciting interactive games, a full-color LCD screen, and advanced 3D graphics.
sentences.zh: 与其他掌上游戏机一样，这款设备提供多种互动游戏、全彩液晶屏和先进的三维图像。

grammar.type: 介词短语比较 + 并列宾语
grammar.note: Like other handheld games 作比较状语；featured 后接三项并列内容。

sentences.en: What set it apart was that it incorporated the traditional physical component of children's play: it contained a pedometer, which tracked and awarded points for physical activity (walking, running, biking, skateboarding, climbing stairs).
sentences.zh: 它的独特之处在于加入了儿童游戏中传统的身体活动部分：设备内置计步器，能记录走路、跑步、骑车、滑板和爬楼梯等活动，并按活动量给分。

grammar.type: what 主语从句 + that 表语从句
grammar.note: What set it apart 作主语；that 从句作表语；冒号后解释 physical component；which 修饰 pedometer，并带 tracked 和 awarded 两个谓语。

sentences.en: The child could use the points to enhance various virtual skills needed for the video game.
sentences.zh: 儿童可以用这些积分提升电子游戏中需要的各种虚拟技能。

grammar.type: use sth to do + 过去分词定语
grammar.note: to enhance... 说明积分的用途；needed for the video game 修饰 virtual skills。

sentences.en: The ME2, introduced in mid-2008, catered to kids' huge desire to play video games while countering the negatives, such as associations with lack of exercise and obesity.
sentences.zh: ME2 于2008年年中推出，它既满足儿童玩电子游戏的强烈愿望，也抵消了电子游戏与缺乏运动、肥胖等问题之间的负面联系。

grammar.type: 过去分词插入语 + while doing
grammar.note: introduced in mid-2008 补充 ME2；while countering... 表示在满足需求的同时抵消负面影响；such as 引出例子。

sentences.en: Once you have gained perspective on how trend-related changes in consumer opinions and behaviors impact on your category, you can determine which of our three innovation strategies to pursue.
sentences.zh: 了解与趋势有关的消费者观点和行为变化会怎样影响你的产品品类后，就可以判断应采用三种创新策略中的哪一种。

grammar.type: once 时间/条件从句 + wh-不定式
grammar.note: Once 从句给出前提；how... 作 on 的宾语；which...to pursue 作 determine 的宾语。

sentences.en: When your category's basic value proposition continues to be meaningful for consumers influenced by the trend, the infuse-and-augment strategy will allow you to reinvigorate the category.
sentences.zh: 如果某项趋势没有削弱品类基本价值主张对消费者的意义，就可以采用“注入并扩充”策略，为该品类增添活力。

grammar.type: when 条件从句 + 过去分词定语
grammar.note: When 从句表示适用条件；influenced by the trend 修饰 consumers；allow you to reinvigorate 为 allow sb to do。

sentences.en: If analysis reveals an increasing disparity between your category and consumers' new focus, your innovations need to transcend the category to integrate the two worlds.
sentences.zh: 如果分析显示品类与消费者的新关注点越来越脱节，创新就需要超越原有品类，把两个领域结合起来。

grammar.type: if 条件从句 + 不定式目的状语
grammar.note: If 从句给出条件；need to transcend 为主句谓语；to integrate... 说明超越品类的目的。

sentences.en: Finally, if aspects of the category clash with undesired outcomes of a trend, such as associations with unhealthy lifestyles, there is an opportunity to counteract those changes by reaffirming the core values of your category.
sentences.zh: 最后，如果该品类的某些方面与趋势带来的不良结果相冲突，例如会让人联想到不健康的生活方式，就可以通过重申品类的核心价值来抵消这种变化。

grammar.type: if 条件从句 + There be
grammar.note: if 从句说明第三种策略的适用条件；such as 引出例子；to counteract... 修饰 opportunity；by reaffirming... 说明方法。

sentences.en: Trends - technological, economic, environmental, social, or political - that affect how people perceive the world around them and shape what they expect from products and services present firms with unique opportunities for growth.
sentences.zh: 技术、经济、环境、社会或政治趋势会影响人们理解周围世界的方式，也会塑造他们对产品和服务的期待；这些趋势为企业带来独特的增长机会。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 两个宾语从句
grammar.note: 破折号中列举 trends 的类型；that 引导定语从句，affect 与 shape 并列；how 与 what 从句分别作宾语；主句谓语为 present。

questions.title: Questions 27-31 · Multiple choice
instructions: Choose the correct letter, A, B, C or D.

items.prompt: In the first paragraph, the writer says that most managers: A fail to spot the key consumer trends; B focus only on principal trends; C misinterpret research data; D are unaware of the significant impact trends have on consumers' lives.
Coach was anxious to: A follow competitors; B maintain all prices; C safeguard its luxury-goods reputation; D modify the entire look of its brand.

What point is made about Tesco's Greener Living programme? A It did not require Tesco to modify its core business; B it attracted a more eco-conscious clientele; C its main aim was awareness; D Tesco had done it before.
What does the writer suggest about Nike's strategy? A extremely risky; B only affordable for a major company; C impossible in the past; D it might appear to have few obvious benefits.
What was original about the ME2? A sports-industry technology; B appeal to fitness-minded youth; C use of colourful 3D graphics; D a handheld game addressing concerns about unhealthy lifestyles.

questions.title: Questions 32-37 · Matching companies
instructions: Match each statement with the correct company, A-D.
A Coach · B Tesco · C Nike · D iToys
NB You may use any letter more than once.

items.prompt: It turned the notion that its products could have harmful effects to its own advantage.
It extended its offering by collaborating with another manufacturer.
It implemented an incentive scheme to demonstrate its corporate social responsibility.
It discovered that customers had a positive attitude towards dealing with difficult circumstances.
It responded to a growing lifestyle trend in an unrelated product sector.
It successfully avoided having to charge its customers less for its core products.

questions.title: Questions 38-40 · Matching sentence endings
instructions: Complete each sentence with the correct ending, A-D.
A employ a combination of strategies to maintain your consumer base.
B identify the most appropriate innovation strategy to use.
C emphasise your brand's traditional values with the counteract-and-reaffirm strategy.
D use the combine-and-transcend strategy to integrate the two worlds.

items.prompt: If there are any trend-related changes impacting on your category, you should...
If a current trend highlights a negative aspect of your category, you should...
If the consumers' new focus has an increasing lack of connection with your offering, you should...
